question: What is the thirty-seven-self seat?
premises: Three spokes, twelve-ended, there also beyond-mind three.
Of lotuses white, this is the thirty-seven-self seat.
inference: The verse identifies a white lotus seat of thirty-seven selves with beyond-mind triad.
plain_english: Three spokes, twelve-ended, there also beyond-mind three; of white lotuses, this is the thirty-seven-self seat.
